messages.en:
If you want to get the
hottest furniture, check
out {ff 00 00 06}Tom Nook{ff 00 00 00}'s store daily.
He sometimes has {ff 00 00 02}daily
specials{ff 00 00 00} and {ff 00 00 02}limited-time
offers{ff 00 00 00}, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 14 00}Oh, and check out the
bulletin board, too.{01 00 00 05 00} Great
deals are waiting for you!
messages.et:
Kui sa tahad saada kõige
kuumemat mööblit, käi iga
päev {ff 00 00 06}Tom Nooki{ff 00 00 00} poes.
Tal on vahel {ff 00 00 02}päevapakkumisi
{ff 00 00 00}ja {ff 00 00 02}piiratud ajaga
pakkumisi{ff 00 00 00}, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 14 00}Oh, ja vaata ka
teadetetahvlit.{01 00 00 05 00} Head
tehingud ootavad sind!

messages.en:
Have you been using {ff 00 00 06}Tom
Nook{ff 00 00 00}'s {07 0b 00}{ff 00 00 08}Point-Tracking
Machine{ff 00 00 00}?
{07 0d 00}You definitely need to{01 00 00 0a 00}
become a {ff 00 00 02}gold member{ff 00 00 00}. It's
worth it, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 14 00}And you know, I hear
there's an even higher
status than {ff 00 00 02}gold{ff 00 00 00}!
messages.et:
Kas sa oled kasutanud {ff 00 00 06}Tom
Nooki{ff 00 00 00} {07 0b 00}{ff 00 00 08}punkti-
masinat{ff 00 00 00}?
{07 0d 00}Sa pead kindlasti{01 00 00 0a 00}
saama {ff 00 00 02}kuldliikmeks{ff 00 00 00}. See on
seda väärt, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 14 00}Ja tead, ma kuulsin, et
on olemas isegi kõrgem
staatus kui {ff 00 00 02}kuld{ff 00 00 00}!

messages.en:
{0b 03 00}{04 1f 00},{01 00 00 05 00} {07 0b 00}have you
visited any other towns
yet, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?{02 00 00 03 04}
I sure have!
I'm scared to!
messages.et:
{0b 03 00}{04 1f 00},{01 00 00 05 00} {07 0b 00}kas sa oled
käinud juba mõnes teises
linnas, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?{02 00 00 03 04}
Olen küll!
Ma kardan!

messages.en:
I have a favor to ask.{01 00 00 05 00} Next
time you travel, {07 0b 00}would
you get me something?
Preferably some of that
town's special furniture, if
you can, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
messages.et:
Mul on üks palve.{01 00 00 05 00} Järgmine
kord, kui sa reisid, {07 0b 00}kas sa
tooksid mulle midagi?
Soovitavalt selle linna
erilist mööblit, kui
saad, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.

messages.en:
{07 04 00}Oh!{01 00 00 0a 00} {07 16 00}What are you so
afraid of, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?

Don't you know that, if you
never leave our town, you'll
never find certain items?
{07 00 00}That's right! Each town has
a different selection of
furniture, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 04 00}Oh!{01 00 00 0a 00} {07 16 00}Mida sa nii väga
kardad, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?

Kas sa ei tea, et kui sa
meie linnast ei lahku,
ei leia sa teatud esemeid?
{07 00 00}Just nii! Igas linnas on
erinev valik
mööblit, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 16 00}I've never visited another
town. I don't know if I'll
get the chance to, either!
That's why I'm always happy
to see people visiting from
other towns, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 16 00}Ma pole kunagi teises
linnas käinud. Ei tea, kas
ma üldse võimalust saan!
Sellepärast on mul alati hea
meel näha külalisi teistest
linnadest, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
